newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axa shares gain on NatMut contribution.
newsitem.headline: Axa shares gain on NatMut contribution.

text.p: Shares in French insurer Axa outperformed the bourse on Friday after the company said its Australian unit National Mutual Holdings would contribute 291 million francs to 1996 net income, brokers said.

"The contribution of National Mutual Holdings, 51 percent held by Axa, to Axa's 1996 income (net of minority interests) amounts to 291 million francs," it said in a statement. "This compares very favourably with the pro forma contribution for 1995, which amounted to 125 million."
Axa's stock was up 1.23 percent at 330 francs at 1115 GMT, while the bourse's CAC index was up 0.59 percent.
